Claude Code: commands, agents, skills, hooks, mcp are installed by the package's own registration through its distribution shell, or the built-in plugin marketplace — nothing to write.
  They come from the registration projectstore@projectstore-npm, not registered on this run, see below — install path <home>/.claude/plugins/cache/projectstore-npm/projectstore/<version>; the host loads them in place from <home>/.claude/projectstore/marketplace/projectstore.
  Two channels. `npx projectstore-claude install --project <dir>` registers the plugin for that project from the npm package itself — the shell bundles the core and fixes the harness; the core's low-level form is `npx projectstore install --harness claude-code --project <dir>` — through a local marketplace under the Claude home, driven by Claude Code's own `claude plugin` CLI. `/plugin install projectstore@SmartAndPoint` installs it from the git marketplace. `/plugin` lists and toggles either. Upgrading the npm registration is `npx projectstore-claude@<version> upgrade --project <dir>` — that is also the pin.
    npx projectstore-claude install --project "$PWD"   (npm; registers the plugin for this project — the shell runs the core's install with the harness fixed)
    /plugin marketplace add SmartAndPoint/ProjectStore && /plugin install projectstore@SmartAndPoint   (git marketplace, user-wide)
    restart Claude Code
  Git marketplace only: auto-update is OFF by default for third-party plugins: /plugin -> Marketplaces -> SmartAndPoint -> toggle auto-update. The npm registration updates when you run `npx projectstore-claude upgrade --project <dir>`.
  Pin a git-marketplace release with: /plugin marketplace add SmartAndPoint/ProjectStore#<tag>; pin the npm registration with npx projectstore-claude@<version>.
  Two enabled copies of the plugin (git marketplace and npm) in one checkout would load twice; the npm registration silences the other one for that checkout only (settings.local.json), and says so in its preview.
  From a checkout instead: claude --plugin-dir ./ProjectStore
  The npm registration is per checkout (local scope) and per machine; a fresh clone or a new worktree runs the install command again. It must run from a terminal outside a Claude Code session: the host CLI and a live session both rewrite settings files.
  https://github.com/SmartAndPoint/ProjectStore#install--one-message

Codex: hooks, skills are installed by the package's portable plugin root, registered through its distribution shell and Codex's own marketplace CLI — nothing to write.
  They come from the registration projectstore@projectstore-npx, not registered on this run, see below.
  The shell does not edit Codex's registry or cache. It atomically stages the plugin source, previews the host commands, then runs `codex plugin marketplace add` and `codex plugin add`; a read-back verifies the installed version and payload digest. The global plugin survives ordinary project uninstall; `uninstall --global` is the explicit destructive form.
    npx projectstore-codex install --project "$PWD"
    restart Codex and approve the ProjectStore hooks when prompted
    run `$projectstore-bind <vault-path>` in Codex
  The installation is user-global because Codex's marketplace, plugin row and cache live in CODEX_HOME; the AGENTS.md block is project-local.
  Upgrade with `npx projectstore-codex@<version> upgrade --project "$PWD"`; the named package version is also the plugin version.
  A second enabled ProjectStore plugin from another marketplace is a refusal, not silently disabled globally. Remove or disable that older registration explicitly, then retry.
  Ordinary uninstall removes only project-owned surfaces. `npx projectstore-codex uninstall --global --project "$PWD"` also removes the user-global plugin registration after a preview.
  https://github.com/SmartAndPoint/ProjectStore#install--one-message

items.reason: `codex` is not on PATH — the registration needs the host CLI

Measured: told to run projectstore:critic, Codex spawned six of its own generic subagents named after our roster and briefed them itself; none of our agents/*.md prose reached them. No route from a plugin's agents/ entry to that mechanism has been found (roadmap B4).

Shipping commands/ is actively harmful here: Codex rewrites them into skills itself and keeps ${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT} in the body, producing entry points that exit 1 with Cannot find module '/bin/projectstore.mjs' (reproduced). The generator renders them as skills instead (roadmap B5).

Our .mcp.json is in Claude Code's dialect: its argv carries ${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT} and ${CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR}, which nothing substitutes there, so the server failed its handshake and printed a red error in every session. Ships only once the Codex dialect is rendered and the spike's criterion (h) says what cwd and environment the server receives.

No status-line mechanism was found in the harness — no settings slot, no plugin field, no handler contract. Recorded as a row rather than an absence so the generator's coverage invariant sees a stated omission (contract 9) instead of a surface that quietly does not exist here.
